card.text: Explore Galatea through its Voyager-derived shape model.

introduction.text: Galatea is a small, elongated moon just inside Neptune’s Adams ring. Its gravity disturbs the ring; Voyager images constrain its shape but do not reveal a usable surface map.

model.title: Approximate shape model
model.summary: Shape estimated from blurred Voyager images. Local terrain is unresolved; gray grid: no mapped imagery.
